biotools.summary: META-DIFF is a k-mer-based pipeline designed for metagenomics whole genome sequencing to detect differentially abundant sequences. It performs differential abundance analysis independently of prior taxonomic or functional annotation, providing high exploratory power for microbiome change analysis.
